newsitems.title: "Pukaland Travelogue" Limited-Time Event
newsitems.author: PWM Game Manager
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46134382/308b2988c4e423cff60ebe4d4116e5809bc375af.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Welcome to Pukaland, where your magical journey begins! Collect Wonder Stamps and unlock your exclusive park memories.[/p][p][/p][p][b]● Available[/b][/p][p]September 30 (after update) – November 11, 05:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p][b]● Rewards[/b][/p][p]During the event, complete limited-time encounters to earn Annulith, Fabricated Dice, Floe Cinema Tickets, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, and more.[/p][p][/p][p][b]●Pukaland Gameplay Overview[/b][/p][p][b]Candy Jar Raid[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46134382/4ac8e27fa4d028cc77cdf889dfaaacdc1543901b.png"][/img][/p][p]"In Candy Jar Raid, press the corresponding Movement keys to rotate your view, and hold the Shoot key to fire. Switch between Cannonballs and Forks depending on the situation.[/p][p]Use Cannonballs to knock back approaching octopus tentacles and protect the cup's Durability. Use Forks to collect Treasure Chests and Treasure Maps for points. Be careful—if the cup's Durability reaches zero, the game will end early with a low rating."[/p][p]"If a powerful tentacle grabs you, quickly repel the other attacking tentacles to avoid losing a large amount of points and durability.[/p][p]Collect all Treasure Maps to unlock a special challenge stage. Defeat all Golden Tentacles to clear the challenge and unlock a special ending. Give it your all!"[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Flora Maze[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46134382/302378425adbb0e39303c4d34de61e26ec2d90f9.png"][/img][/p][p]"In Flora Maze, players spawn at random locations, and the maze layout changes each round.[/p][p]Explore the maze, find the exit, and escape! Collect all the scattered playing cards and rescue every trapped Pukaboo to earn additional rewards."[/p][p]"Lollipop Goggles reveal the location of the exit, but also make the timer run faster. Pick up other items to gain more time. Approach special bushes to uncover hidden paths—but be careful, some bushes move on their own![/p][p]If you fail to escape before time runs out, the challenge will end early with a low rating. Good luck out there!"[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Pixies Waltz[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46134382/a8f1d89593ee53510041f54a621344f6f0d471c3.png"][/img][/p][p]"In Pixies Waltz, press the corresponding direction when the green cursor reaches the center of the button to build Firepower.[/p][p]Your timing will be rated Perfect, Normal, or Miss."[/p][p]"Reach the top of the tower to enter first-person shooting mode. Spend Firepower to shoot down airborne candy and earn points![/p][p]If half of the Firepower you gain in a single run is earned with a Perfect rating, a special challenge stage will unlock. Clear it to reach the special ending. Give it your best shot!"[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Punchulum Ride[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46134382/f4ace1fc60b92f8d542b0e12575334dc83219060.png"][/img][/p][p]"In the Punchulum Ride, press the corresponding Movement key when each circle appears to earn points.[/p][p]There are three types of inputs: press, hold, and repeated press. Watch the colors carefully to know which one to use.[/p][p]Pink Candy Ring: Press once[/p][p]Blue Candy Ring: Hold[/p][p]Orange Candy Ring: Press repeatedly"[/p][p]"Mistakes increase your character's Fear, while successful inputs reduce it. If Fear gets too high, the game will end early and you'll receive a low rating.[/p][p]Land multiple Perfects to unlock a special challenge stage. Clear it to reach the special ending. Give it your best shot!"[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Lavaton Gold Rush[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46134382/eb8b5bbb228c74f65bee861d55459b3782be5b5a.png"][/img][/p][p]In Lavaton Gold Rush, use the Movement and Jump keys to control the mine cart. Switch between adjacent tracks to dodge obstacles, pick up weapons to destroy them, and collect coins to earn points.[/p][p]"While airborne, you can steer the mine cart left or right to choose which track to land on, though your movement will be limited during lava eruptions. On steep tracks, press the Speed Up key to make it up the slope.[/p][p]Hitting obstacles or derailing will cost you points. Lose too many points, and the game will end early with a low score."[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

newsitems.title: Foretold Finale Limited Board
newsitems.author: PWM Game Manager
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46134382/c0800c2fc2887f9bafb0936538f69cd39a905805.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]● Available[/b][/p][p]September 30, 2026 (after update) – October 21, 2026, 05:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p][/p][p][b]● Unlock Requirement[/b][/p][p]Complete the Episode Quest "Prologue: A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"[/p][p][/p][p][b]● Featuring[/b][/p][p]1. The "Foretold Finale" board features the limited S-class character Blackbird, along with A-class characters Mint, Edgar, and Adler.[/p][p]2. The board also features "The Harbinger" glider livery, the "Nightplume" Yesteryear bike livery, and Blackbird's "Rouge et Noir" outfit.[/p][p][/p][p][b]● Board Rules[/b][/p][p]1. The "Foretold Finale" board uses Solid Dice or Divination Dice. Roll to move 1–6 tiles (equal chance), land on a tile, and claim the displayed reward.[/p][p]2. All Limited Boards share the same S-class character pity counter, Points Gift progress, and Board Modification progress.[/p][p]3. Skin Perks on "Foretold Finale" are time-limited and exclusive to this board. Progress does not carry over to other Limited Boards. Skin Perks for this board include: Daily Outfit, Mod Up! (Livery), and Fashion Center.[/p][p]4. All boards start as Baseline. If the featured S-class character doesn't drop within 70 consecutive rolls, the board upgrades to Modified (rate up). Once you obtain the featured S-class character, the board resets to Baseline.[/p][p]5. If you haven't obtained the featured S-class character after 89 rolls, your 90th roll automatically grants them (your piece will not move). The featured S-class character is guaranteed within 90 rolls.[/p][p]6. Blackbird is currently only available from the "Foretold Finale" Limited Board, with no other ways to obtain her planned at this time.[/p][p][/p][p]*For full details, head to Scarborough Fair in-game.[/p][p][/p]

newsitems.title: NTE Steam Login FAQ
newsitems.author: PWM Game Manager
newsitems.contents: [p]Hey, Appraisers![/p][p][/p][p]On \[08/19/2026], NTE will be adding Steam account login support. If you're a new player, you can simply log in with Steam to jump right into the game. If you're an existing player with game progress and want to link that to your Steam account, be sure to log in to NTE using your existing game account first, and then go to \[User Center] > \[Steam] to link your Steam account.[/p][p][/p][p]We've also put together a list of FAQs below for your reference. If you have any other questions, feel free to reach out to Customer Support at [url="https://nte.contactus@perfectworld.com"]nte.contactus@perfectworld.com[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Q: I've already logged in to NTE using my Steam account. Can I still link another game account that already has progress?[/p][p]A: No. Logging in with a Steam account automatically creates a brand-new User ID, and that Steam account can't be linked to another game account with existing progress.[/p][p][/p][p]Q: If I play on Steam with my Steam account, can I continue playing on other platforms?[/p][p]A: Yes. After you link your Steam account to an email address in the User Center, you can use that email to log in on other platforms and keep your game progress synced.[/p][p][/p][p]Q: My Steam account is linked to an email address / Facebook / Google. Can I unlink them later?[/p][p]A: You can unlink third-party login accounts like Facebook, Google, and Steam in the User Center. Email accounts cannot be unlinked. Please proceed with care.[/p][p][/p][p]Q: If I unlink a Steam account from my email account, which account keeps the game progress?[/p][p]A: Once the unlinking is complete, your character progress will remain with your email account.[/p][p][/p][p]Q: Can I link a Steam account on mobile or other clients?[/p][p]A: No. Currently, only the Steam game client supports Steam account login and linking.[/p][p][/p][p]Q: Can an unlinked Steam account be linked to a different game account?[/p][p]A: Yes. Once unlinked, your Steam account returns to an unused state and is ready to be linked to another NTE game account that isn't already linked to Steam. The process still follows the same order: log in to the target game account first, then link Steam.[/p]

Each round of "Shadow-n-Seek" now costs City Stamina.[/p][p]◆ Added an "Outfit Rotation" feature: when enabled, a random outfit you own is selected and equipped from that character's wardrobe each time you log in or change scenes.[/p][p]◆ Adjusted and improved "Going, Going, Gone!": Added seasonal Profit and Wealth Leaderboards, along with matching seasonal quests and rewards; added a venue conditions mechanic; added an in-match quick chat system with preset phrases; added 20 brand-new collectibles and improved the collectible spawn algorithm; adjusted collectible spawn rates across sessions and slightly increased the spawn rate of "Eternal Heart".[/p][p]◆ Added Bond quests for Zankou.[/p][p]◆ Added new Bond interactions for Zankou: reach the required Bond Level to unlock her passenger seat ride-along.[/p][p]◆ Added a combat tutorial for Zankou.[/p][p]◆ Raised "The Witch's House" level cap to 15.[/p][p]◆ "Bronze Carrota" and "Silver Carrota" can now be crafted into higher-tier Carrota.[/p][p]◆ Some items can now be discarded: use the button in the bottom-left corner of the Inventory screen and select the items you want to discard. newsitems.title: "Going, Going, Gone!" Gameplay Guide
newsitems.author: PWM Game Manager
newsitems.contents: [p]The brand-new auction mini-game "Going, Going, Gone!" is now available. Your goal: build a fortune on sharp, savvy calls. The Treasure Ship Auction starts now![/p][p][/p][p]Event Duration[/p][p]July 29 (after update) – August 19, 05:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p][/p][p]Event Rules[/p][p]1. This mode uses a special auction currency: Gold Shells.[/p][p]2. Before entering an auction, you can freely choose your Auction Assistant and Device Set. There are 3 auction tiers, each with different lots and entry requirements.[/p][p]3. After the auction begins, you will have 5 rounds to place bids. In each round, estimate the total value of the lots within the time limit and submit your bid. Your selected Auction Assistant and items can provide intel to help you appraise the lots.[/p][p]4. If you meet one of the following conditions, you can immediately win all current lots and end the auction:[/p][p]- Round 1: Bid more than 2× the 2nd-highest bid.[/p][p]- Round 2: Bid more than 1.6× the 2nd-highest bid.[/p][p]- Round 3: Bid more than 1.3× the 2nd-highest bid.[/p][p]- Round 4: Bid more than 1.1× the 2nd-highest bid.[/p][p]- Round 5: The highest bidder wins all lots.[/p][p]5. If players are tied in Round 5, the auction enters Round 6. Only the players tied in Round 5 may bid again, and the highest bidder wins all lots. If players are tied again in Round 6, the auction ends with no sale.[/p][p]6. If the winning bidder ends the settlement phase at a loss, each of the other three players receives a bonus equal to 10% of the loss.[/p][p]7. Any collectibles you win are automatically added to your Collection. You can either sell them or put them on display. Displayed collectibles generate income over time.[/p][p][/p][p]Event Rewards[/p][p]Complete event quests and fill out your Item Index to earn the "Highest Bidder Wins" title, the "Choice" avatar frame, the "Deal!" namecard, Annulith, Fons, and more.[/p]

newsitems.title: Shadow-n-Seek: Gameplay Guide

newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46134382/c1da8e9fd59d56a2d03ce6b33e5dae436130e20e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The all-new asymmetric PvP mode Shadow-n-Seek is now live! During each match, you'll be randomly assigned to the Hider or Hunter side for a tense, thrilling showdown of disguise and pursuit.[/p][p][/p][p]Duration[/p][p]July 17, 10:00 - August 19, 05:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p][/p][p]The Two Sides[/p][p]🎭 Hider: When the match begins, you get a prep window to explore the map and pick one of three items to disguise yourself. Once transformed, you look just like an ordinary object in the scene, making you tough for Hunters to spot! You can't attack while hidden, so rely on moving, repositioning, and planting decoys to stay out of the Hunters' hands.[/p][p]🔍 Hunter: You have 2 minutes and 20 seconds to track down and catch every Hider! Hunters have a scanning ability; land a hit on a Hider to trigger the catch. But be careful: swing at the wrong target and the backlash costs you HP, so look closely before you strike![/p][p][/p][p]Win Conditions[/p][p]Hiders win: at least 2 Hiders are still alive when the timer runs out, or all Hunters' HP is depleted.[/p][p]Hunters win: catch every Hider before time runs out.[/p][p][/p][p]Event Rewards[/p][p]Take part in the event to earn the event currency "Paper Cup Phone", then visit the Shadebound Shop to redeem rewards like the "Gotcha!" avatar frame, Annulith, Floe Cinema Ticket, and Fons.[/p]

newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46134382/e31b02e6cddd74bba3168563b043bbee5fd70ff9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hey Appraiser,[/p][p]NTE will undergo version maintenance on July 8, 2026 from 06:00 to 11:00 (UTC+8). Once it's done, the all-new Version 1.2 "999 Nights" goes live. "Pink Paws Heist" will be temporarily unavailable starting at 05:30 (UTC+8) and will reopen once maintenance wraps up.[/p][p]Login will be unavailable during this period, so please plan accordingly. Since this update is on the larger side, we recommend using Wi-Fi or mobile data to complete the download. We apologize for any inconvenience![/p][p]※ The "Forsaken Path" Limited Board ends on July 8, 2026, at 05:59 (UTC+8). Be sure to head to the Fogshroud Perks page and redeem your rewards before then.[/p][p][/p][p]\[Summer Special Gift Pack][/p][p]Create a character before Version 1.2 ends to receive an S-Class Standard Character Selection Box.[/p][p]Duration: July 8 (after update) – August 19, 05:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]Distribution: Sent via in-game mail after maintenance. Remember to claim the items before they expire.[/p][p]※ Open the S-Class Standard Character Selection Box to choose any one of these characters to add to your roster: Sakiri, Baicang, Hathor, Fadia, Daffodill, or Jiuyuan.[/p][p][/p][p]\[Appreciation Gift][/p][p]Since launch, we have received invaluable feedback from our Appraisers to help improve the game. We sincerely apologize for any current shortcomings and are actively working to optimize the overall experience in upcoming updates.[/p][p]Thank you for your patience and continued support. As a token of our gratitude, we are distributing the following gift:[/p][p]● Appreciation Gift: Annulith x1,600[/p][p]● Delivery: Sent via in-game mail after the July 8, 2026 update.[/p][p]● Eligibility: Appraisers who create a character and unlock the "Mail" feature before Version 1.2 ends.[/p][p][/p][p]\[Maintenance & Compensation][/p][p]● Duration: July 8, 2026, 06:00–11:00 (UTC+8)[/p][p]● Maintenance Compensation: Annulith x300[/p][p]● Eligibility: Appraisers who created their character before July 8, 2026, 06:00 (UTC+8)[/p][p]● Distribution: Sent via in-game mail after maintenance. Remember to claim the items before they expire.[/p][p]※ Maintenance may end earlier or later than scheduled depending on actual progress. Please keep an eye on our official announcements for updates.[/p][p]● Bug Fix Compensation: Annulith x300[/p][p]● Eligibility: Appraisers who created their character before July 8, 2026, 06:00 (UTC+8)[/p][p]● Distribution: Sent via in-game mail after maintenance. Remember to claim the items before they expire.[/p][p][/p][p]\[How to Update][/p][p]PC: Close the game, reopen the launcher, and click Update.[/p][p]Android: Launch the game and follow the in-game update prompt.[/p][p]iOS: Download or update from the App Store.[/p][p]Mac: Download or update from the App Store.[/p][p]PlayStation®: Open the system menu, select NTE, press the OPTIONS button on your controller, choose Confirm Upgrade, then select Check for Update.[/p][p][/p][p]\[Update Details][/p][p]1. New Character & Arc[/p][p]● New Exclusive S-Class Character: Shinku![/p][p]Available: July 8 (after update) – July 29, 05:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"[/p][p]Board Details: The "Before the Dawn" Limited Board features the exclusive S-Class character Shinku, along with A-Class characters Mint, Edgar, and Adler.[/p][p]During the event, the "Before the Dawn" Limited Board also features the "Overcast Canopy" glider livery, the "Hidden Dragon" Blizzard-V4 livery, and Shinku's outfit "Student of Terrasea". Claim them from the Resolve Perks page by accumulating 50/120/200 rolls, or obtain them randomly through rolls before reaching these milestones.[/p][p]*For full details, head to Scarborough Fair in-game.[/p][p]● New Limited S-Class Arc: "Blushing Mirage"[/p][p]Available: July 8 (after update) – July 29, 05:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"[/p][p]Research Guide: Spend Tri-Keys or Resolve Keys to participate in the "Resolve Special" Arc Research Program and obtain the limited S-Class Arc "Blushing Mirage". This Arc is currently only available through this program.[/p][p]*For full details, head to Arc Shop › Arc Research Program in-game.[/p][p][/p][p]2. New Story[/p][p]● New Main Story Episode: "Fighting with a Dragon"[/p][p]Ready to go? Our fantastical adventure is about to begin![/p][p]Available: After the Version 1.2 update[/p][p]Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story episode "Dreamwalk Corridor" and reach Hunter Lvl 26.[/p][p]※ The new location Warren Continent can be reached during the main story episode "Fighting with a Dragon".[/p][p]※ In response to the concerns many Appraisers have shared about the continuation of the "Dreamwalk Corridor" storyline, we'd like to clarify: this main story episode is told out of chronological order, using a flashback structure. It depicts a lighter, more relaxed chapter set after the dust has settled on the "Scarlet Letter" incident, once everyone has returned to their peaceful daily lives. A new fantasy adventure is about to begin. Dive in and have a blast.[/p][p]● City Hangouts[/p][p]A new City Hangouts story featuring Shinku.[/p][p]Available: After the Version 1.2 update[/p][p]Unlock Requirement: Obtain the character Shinku, or complete the main story episode "Fighting with a Dragon".[/p][p]● Home Time[/p][p]A new Invitation mode featuring Shinku.[/p][p]Available: After the Version 1.2 update[/p][p]Unlock Requirement: Obtain the character Shinku and reach the required Bond Level.[/p][p][/p][p]3. New Location[/p][p]● New Location: Warren Continent (reachable during the main story episode "Fighting with a Dragon")[/p][p]A vast land brimming with fantasy, with adventures, challenges, and opportunities hiding in every corner. What lies at the next crossroads?[/p][p][/p][p]4. New Outfits & Vehicle Liveries[/p][p]● Shinku's new outfit "Dragonhunter" is now available in the Shop[/p][p]Discount Period: July 8 (after update) – August 19, 05:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]Discount Price: Riftcrystal x2,680[/p][p]Original Price: Riftcrystal x3,280 (18% off, limited time)[/p][p]Shop Availability: Permanent[/p][p]● Shinku's new outfit "Dawn Patrol" is now available in the Shop[/p][p]Discount Period: July 8 (after update) – August 19, 05:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]Discount Price: Riftcrystal x1,680[/p][p]Original Price: Riftcrystal x2,480 (32% off, limited time)[/p][p]Shop Availability: Permanent[/p][p]● Shinku's new outfit "Student of Terrasea"[/p][p]How to Get: While the "Before the Dawn" Limited Board is active, roll on the board and land on the matching tile to obtain the outfit, or claim it from the Resolve Perks page once you've accumulated enough rolls.[/p][p]● Shinku's new outfit "Labyrinth Lily"[/p][p]How to Get: Unlocked after you obtain Shinku and reach Bond Lvl 10.[/p][p]● Shinku's new outfit "Normie Heroine"[/p][p]How to Get: Purchased from the "999 Nights" Button Shop.[/p][p]● The Porsche 918 Spyder exclusive liveries "Tomato Dash" and "Rose & Violet" are now available in the Shop[/p][p]Available: After the July 8 version update (UTC+8)[/p][p]Price: Riftcrystal x980 or Fons x3,000,000[/p][p]*Purchase using either Riftcrystal or Fons; only one option may be selected.[/p][p][/p][p]5. New Mystery Box Event "Neon Rift" Goes Live[/p][p]Duration: July 8 (after update) – August 19, 05:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]Details: Spend Fons or Annulith to open "Neon Rift" Mystery Boxes. The cost goes up with each box you open. There are 15 boxes in total, and opening all of them unlocks every reward in the pool.[/p][p]Mystery Box Contents: The "Neon Rift" Mystery Boxes feature the limited vehicle "Draco", Esper Zero's exclusive outfit "Glory Days", Esper Zero's exclusive outfit colors "Glory Days - Starfall" and "Glory Days - Braveheart", Fabricated Dice x10, A Handwritten Letter, Fons x100,000, and the exclusive avatar frame "Ember Trail".[/p][p][/p][p]6. New Events[/p][p]● "Circle Gifts" Login Event[/p][p]Duration: July 8 (after update) – August 19, 05:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]Details: Log in for a total of 7 days to earn Solid Dice x10.[/p][p]● "999 Nights" Limited-Time Event[/p][p]Duration: July 8 (after update) – August 19, 05:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]Details: The party's assembled! Ready to conquer all of Warren Continent! Take part during the event to earn rewards like Annulith, Fabricated Dice, Fons, Floe Cinema Tickets, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, and more.[/p][p]● "Shadow-n-Seek" Limited-Time Event[/p][p]Duration: July 17, 10:00 – August 19, 05:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]Details: One, two, three... don't move a muscle! During the event, take part to earn the event currency "Paper Cup Phone", then visit the Shadebound Shop to redeem rewards like the "Gotcha!" avatar frame, Annulith, Floe Cinema Tickets, Fons, and more.[/p][p]● "Stamina Recharge" Limited-Time Event[/p][p]Duration: July 13, 05:00 – July 20, 04:59 (server time)[/p][p]Details: During the event, City Stamina is consumed at 2x efficiency in "Hethereau Hobbies" activities.[/p][p]● "Gold Clash" Limited-Time Event[/p][p]Duration: July 20, 05:00 – August 3, 04:59 (server time)[/p][p]Details: During the event, earn Fons at 2x efficiency in "Pink Paws Heist".[/p][p][/p][p]7. Other Content[/p][p]● "Eibon Partner Program" Now Live[/p][p]Duration: July 8, 2026, 11:00 – August 19, 05:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]Details: During the event, Appraisers can earn rewards like Annulith by inviting Returning Appraisers back to the game.[/p][p]Appraiser Share your invite code or invite link to bring back eligible Returning Appraisers, and earn base rewards plus Lucky Draw chances.[/p][p]Once Returning Appraisers log in and finish the 3-day quests, they can also share their own invite code to bring other eligible Appraisers back and join the web event.[/p][p]※ Returning Appraiser status can take a moment to update. If it hasn't refreshed, wait 2 to 4 minutes and reload the page.[/p][p]● "999 Nights" Mini-Game[/p][p]Available: After the Version 1.2 update[/p][p]Details: Take part to earn "Mystery Buttons", then head to the Button Shop to redeem event rewards including Shinku's new outfit "Normie Heroine"; Esper Zero's outfits "Unassuming Warrior" and "The Blademaster"; Esper Zero's exclusive outfit colors "The Blademaster - Ocher", "The Blademaster - Morningstar", and "The Blademaster - Verdant"; Mint's outfits "Wild as the Wind", "Sylvan Hunter", and "Aurora Flame"; Mint's exclusive outfit colors "Sylvan Hunter - Ridge", "Sylvan Hunter - Lilac", "Sylvan Hunter - Bloomwhisper", "Aurora Flame - Shadeleaf", and "Aurora Flame - Dreammere"; Esper Zero's "Unassuming Warrior" dye orb set; Mint's "Wild as the Wind" dye orb set; the title "Dawn Warrior"; the namecard "Forever Fuzzy"; the avatar "Poet's Epilogue"; the avatar frame "Moonlit Dragon"; plus Annulith, Floe Cinema Tickets, Fons, and more.[/p][p]● Version 1.2 "Circle Bounty" Guide[/p][p]Available: July 8 (after update) – August 18, 23:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]Requirement: Complete the Main Quest "Relax Time"[/p][p]Details: During the event, take on Circle Quests to earn Experience Points, raise your Circle Bounty Rank, and claim rewards like Fabricated Dice, Gold Carrota, De-noise Solution, A Handwritten Letter, and Expansion Cores.[/p][p]Purchase Elite Hunter Supplies to unlock extra rewards as you rank up, including Annulith x680, Solid Dice x4, Fabricated Dice x2, Arc-light Trove x1, A Handwritten Letter x2, and Fons x700,000![/p][p]Purchase Honor Hunter Supplies to unlock all of the above rewards, plus the "Fuzzy" avatar, the "New Game+++" avatar frame, the "Summer Time" namecard, Fabricated Dice x5, A Handwritten Letter x1, and Fons x500,000![/p][p][/p][p]\[New Optimizations & Bug Fixes][/p][p]◆ Add a teleport point at The Midnight Catzebo, where you can buy scratchers and scratch for prizes. Match the icons shown, and you win the prizes listed beneath them.[/p][p]◆ Add an Outfit Recoloring feature for character outfits.[/p][p]◆ Add Riichi Mahjong to Little Sparrow.[/p][p]◆ Add a Fishkeeping feature.[/p][p]◆ Add a Decor Blueprint feature.  [/p][p]◆ Add Bond quests for Shinku.[/p][p]◆ Add Bond interactions for Shinku: reach the required Bond Level to unlock her passenger seat ride-along.[/p][p]◆ Add text message conversations with Shinku.[/p][p]◆ Add a combat tutorial for Shinku.[/p][p]◆ Add Random Encounters for Iroi.[/p][p]◆ Add the ability to display rare big fish on the back of your car.[/p][p]◆ Add simplified controls for the Portable Player.[/p][p]◆ Add a Player Reporting feature to Races - Online Battle mode.[/p][p]◆ Add the ability to share Home Decor Blueprints.[/p][p]◆ Raise the furniture Collection level cap and add one-tap collect. (If your Collection already went over the old cap before this update, the excess is now counted normally.)[/p][p]◆ Improve Fight Club results scoring so knockouts and damage dealt count for more toward final rank and rewards.[/p][p]◆ Add several new side quests.[/p][p]◆ Reduce the difficulty of Anomaly Hunts at Appraisal Lvl 5 and above.[/p][p]◆ Add long-press to bulk select upgrade materials when leveling up characters, Arcs, and Consoles.[/p][p]◆ Add an option to hide parts and accessories on select outfits. (After this update, toggling Chaos's mask on or off moves from the G key to its own option in the Settings menu.)   [/p][p]◆ Convertible tops now stay down after your character gets out of the car.[/p][p]◆ Add a semi-automatic throttle mode on mobile, toggleable in Settings.[/p][p]◆ Add a Settings toggle for Arc special effects.[/p][p]◆ Improve the elevator in the Pegasus Residence.[/p][p]◆ Improvements to Bagel.[/p][p]◆ Improve in-game avatar display.[/p][p]◆ Improve controller support.[/p][p]◆ Fix an issue where the quest log text could linger after completing Chaos's Encounter quest.[/p][p]◆ Fix an issue where triggering an Anomaly Commission could break quest auto-tracking.[/p][p]◆ Fix an issue where the new outfit notification dot could linger after switching your Appraiser's gender.[/p][p]◆ Fix an issue where characters could get stuck at the table after leaving a Little Sparrow matchmaking room.[/p][p]◆ Fix an issue where Hotori's Basic Attack button could disappear unexpectedly after casting her Ultimate.[/p][p]◆ Fix an issue where the button to use the soap item fails to display properly in Fight Club when using a controller.[/p][p]◆ Fix crashes that could occur in certain situations.[/p][p]◆ Improve localization for several languages.[/p][p]◆ Address various other known issues.[/p]

newsitems.title: NTE is coming to Steam on July 8!
newsitems.author: PWM Game Manager
newsitems.contents: [p]Hey Appraisers,[/p][p]NTE officially launches on Steam on July 8.[/p][p]The Steam version supports cross-progression with existing platforms (mobile, PC, and more) across the Asia, America, Europe, and SEA servers, and launches straight into NTE's Version 1.2 content![/p][p][/p][p]📺 Version 1.2 Preview Special Program[/p][p]Follow this link to watch the livestream replay and learn about all the fun stuff coming in Version 1.2.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/I43_jprQv_s"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Wishlist it on Steam today, and start your Hethereau adventure on July 8![/p]
